prompt:
Use $necromancer at .agents/skills/necromancer/SKILL.md.

Review two proposed independent simplifications in amounts.amount_cents:
(A) remove the isinstance(value, int) early return;
(B) replace the final quantized return with return int(Decimal(value) * 100),
leaving the early return unchanged. Do not combine the proposals.
For each, establish why the existing behavior was introduced from the actual
relevant commit change, then decide whether it is necessary under the current
supported invoice contract and caller. Verify current, A-only and B-only behavior
through invoice.invoice_total for "1.005", "-1.005" and "2.34", comparing with
the required values. Cite the introducing commits and current call path. Give
separate recommendations, separating historical reason from current necessity.
This is review, not implementation: preserve all project files; no commits,
dependency installs, network, publishing or external history fetching. Use -B
for Python. In-memory substitution is permitted. If you need scratch, keep it
inside the project and remove it before finishing; captured output is enough.

Work only inside this synthetic project. Do not use external services or other installed skills. Do not delegate.
personal_skill_disable_verification: not checked; inspect recorded initial context separately

capture_diagnostics.limitation: Empty command output may be legitimate. Nonempty output may still be incomplete. Item errors may be recoverable; review actual execution. These diagnostics neither prove full tool-output capture nor score task success.

pre_collection_index.artifact_scope: Local raw artifact; binary index is not included by exporter

pre_model_project_files.limitation: Local regular-file bytes/modes and symlink targets before model execution; not directory metadata, an atomic snapshot, transient-change evidence, or an automatic preservation verdict. Raw inventory is not exported.

index_comparison.limitation: Before-model versus before-collector byte/mode identity only; not semantic index equality, all Git metadata, or transient-change evidence. Index refresh may change bytes without changing staged content.
